title: Rapid Evidence-on-Demand: Tiered Attestation Credits Based on Questionnaire Effort
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, self-serve "Rapid Evidence-on-Demand" flow that issues tiered ‘attestation credits’ to customers when they complete security questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ or custom). Credits apply to support/engineering evidence preparation time or to offset premium security review fees. Goal: reduce friction in sales cycles and scale questionnaire throughput while quantifying marginal cost of evidence work for pricing experiments.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Customers can request an expedited attestation bundle after completing a guided SIG/CAIQ with an estimate of evidence effort shown before submission.
2) System issues a credits token (attestation-credit) pegged to estimated effort levels (low/medium/high).
3) Credits can be redeemed via self-serve portal or applied automatically to sales support tickets; billing signal visible in console.
4) Product metrics tracked: time-to-closure, reduction in manual SE hours, NPS for onboarding, and revenue impact.
5) Legal and compliance checklist signed off; audit trail captured for each issued credit.
